'''Praadost II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Praadost II was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. Shortly before the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]], it aligned itself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was [[Pacification of Praadost II|subjugated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the forces of which included [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]]. Many civilians died in the battle. Praadost II was located on the Hydian Way.
